These Terms and Conditions, along with the Privacy Policy, Community Guidelines, Creator Programme Terms, and any other policies or terms expressly incorporated by reference (collectively, the "Terms"), govern your access to and use of the POPLI platform, including the website, mobile application, and all associated services, features, and content (the "Platform").

1.3. The POPLI Platform is a social media and short-form content platform designed for users and creators in India. It allows Users to create accounts, upload and share content, interact with other Users, participate in challenges and campaigns, and, for eligible creators, participate in monetization programmes. The Platform is provided for informational, entertainment, and social networking purposes only.

1.5.2. The POPLI Community Guidelines, which set forth the standards of conduct expected of all Users.

Some features may not be available to all Users and may be subject to additional terms and conditions.
2. DEFINITIONS
2.1. "Account" means the user account created by a User on the Platform to access and use the Services.
2.2. "Campaign" means a promotional, marketing, or sponsored initiative conducted on the Platform, which may be organized by POPLI, its partners, or third-party brands.
2.3. "Challenge" means a thematic or competitive activity initiated on the Platform that invites Users to create and submit Content according to specified prompts, rules, or themes.
2.4. "Coins" means the virtual, platform-based tokens available on POPLI, which may be acquired by Users and used for permitted activities on the Platform, including sending Virtual Gifts.
2.5. "Community Guidelines" means the standards, rules, and policies established by POPLI governing User conduct and Content on the Platform, as updated from time to time.

2.6. "Content" means any text, images, graphics, videos, audio, reels, livestreams, comments, captions, profile information, data, or other materials uploaded, posted, shared, or otherwise made available on the Platform by any User.
2.7. "Creator" means a User who has been accepted into the POPLI Creator Programme and is eligible to earn Earnings from their Content.
2.8. "Creator Programme" means the monetization programme operated by POPLI that enables eligible Creators to earn Earnings based on qualifying activity on the Platform.

2.9. "Earnings" means the amounts payable to a Creator arising from their participation in the Creator Programme, including view-based earnings, rewards, gifts, or other monetization opportunities, subject to these Terms and applicable programme rules.

2.10. "Eligible View" means a view of a Creator's Content that meets the criteria established by POPLI for monetization, including but not limited to genuineness, watch duration, geographic eligibility, content eligibility, account eligibility, and compliance with all applicable Platform policies.

2.11. "Invalid Activity" means any activity that artificially inflates or manipulates views, engagement, or any other metric on the Platform, including but not limited to the use of bots, scripts, automated viewing, click farms, view farms, purchased views, engagement exchanges, self-view manipulation, device farms, emulator abuse, repeated artificial refreshing, coordinated manipulation, incentivized fake engagement, fraudulent traffic, automated accounts, exploitation of platform vulnerabilities, and attempts to bypass fraud detection systems.
2.12. "Platform" means the POPLI website, mobile application, and all associated services, features, content, and functionalities provided by POPLI.
2.13. "POPLI" means [LEGAL ENTITY NAME], the operator of the Platform.
2.14. "Reel" means a short-form video or similar content format uploaded and published on the Platform by a User.
2.15. "Rewards" means virtual items, Coins, or other benefits that may be awarded to Users for participating in certain activities, challenges, campaigns, or referral programmes on the Platform.

2.16. "Services" means all services provided by POPLI through the Platform, including but not limited to content hosting, social networking, content discovery, monetization, and any other services offered from time to time.
2.17. "User" means any individual or entity that accesses or uses the Platform, whether as a viewer, content creator, or otherwise.
2.18. "User Content" means any Content that a User uploads, posts, shares, or otherwise makes available on the Platform.
2.19. "Virtual Gift" means a virtual item that a User may send to a Creator on the Platform, which may have a value in Coins and may be converted to Earnings for eligible Creators.

You and your parent or legal guardian shall be jointly and severally liable for your compliance with these Terms.

3.4. You must have the legal capacity to enter into a binding contract under applicable law. If you are using the Platform on behalf of an organization, you represent that you have the authority to bind such organization to these Terms.
3.5. You must not have been previously suspended, terminated, or barred from using the Platform by POPLI, unless you have received explicit written permission to create a new Account.

3.6. The Platform is primarily designed for Users in India. Access to the Platform and certain features may be restricted in jurisdictions where the provision of such services is prohibited by applicable law. 6.5. POPLI reserves the right, but does not assume the obligation, to review, moderate, filter, restrict, remove, or refuse to display any User Content that violates these Terms, the Community Guidelines, or applicable law, or that POPLI reasonably determines to be inappropriate or harmful.

10.2. Without limiting the foregoing, you agree not to upload, post, share, or engage in any activity involving Content or conduct that:

10.2.2. Harasses, threatens, intimidates, bullies, or abuses any individual or group, or encourages others to do so.

10.2.3. Promotes hate speech, discrimination, or abuse based on race, ethnicity, national origin, religion, caste, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability, age, or any other protected characteristic.

10.2.4. Depicts, promotes, or facilitates sexual exploitation, sexual abuse, or any non-consensual sexual content, including child sexual abuse material, non-consensual intimate content, and any other content that exploits minors.

10.2.10. Violates any intellectual property rights, including copyright, trademark, patent, or trade secret rights.
10.2.11. Manipulates engagement metrics, including views, likes, comments, shares, or followers, through fraudulent or artificial means.
10.2.12. Contains malicious software, viruses, worms, trojan horses, or any other harmful code.
10.2.13. Promotes, facilitates, or facilitates access to illegal goods, services, or activities.
10.2.14. Is otherwise unlawful, harmful, offensive, or inappropriate as determined by POPLI in its reasonable discretion.
10.3. You agree to interact with other Users in a respectful and courteous manner. You shall not engage in any conduct that is intended to harass, annoy, or intimidate other Users.

11.3.2. Restrict the reach, visibility, or discoverability of any User Content.

11.5. POPLI complies with applicable laws and regulations, including the Information Technology (Intermediary Guidelines and Digital Media Ethics Code) Rules, 2021, and other relevant laws, regarding content moderation, grievance redressal, and reporting obligations.
12. REPORTING CONTENT AND USERS

12.1. POPLI encourages Users to report any Content or User behaviour that violates these Terms, the Community Guidelines, or applicable law. Reports may be submitted through the reporting mechanisms available on the Platform.
12.2. When submitting a report, you agree to provide accurate and complete information, including:
12.2.1. A description of the reported Content or behaviour.
12.2.2. Sufficient information to enable POPLI to locate the reported Content, such as the URL or username.
12.2.3. The basis for the report, including which Term or Community Guideline has been violated.
12.2.4. Your contact information, if necessary for further investigation.
12.3. You agree not to submit false, frivolous, or vexatious reports. Submitting false reports may result in the suspension or termination of your Account and may subject you to legal liability.

12.4. Upon receipt of a report, POPLI shall review the reported Content or conduct in accordance with its procedures and applicable law. POPLI shall take appropriate action, which may include removal of Content, restriction of features, suspension of accounts, or other measures as determined by POPLI.

12.5. POPLI may, in its discretion, provide an appeals mechanism for Users who believe their Content or Account has been subject to erroneous moderation action. Information about the appeals process, if available, will be provided through the Platform.

12.6. POPLI shall act in accordance with applicable laws and regulations, including the Information Technology (Intermediary Guidelines and Digital Media Ethics Code) Rules, 2021, with respect to the handling of reports and grievances.
13. CREATOR PROGRAMME

13.1. The POPLI Creator Programme is a monetization programme that enables eligible Creators to earn Earnings from their Content on the Platform. Participation in the Creator Programme is by invitation or application, subject to acceptance by POPLI.

13.2. Monetization is not automatically available to every User. You must meet the eligibility requirements set forth in these Terms and the Creator Programme Terms to participate in the Creator Programme.
13.3. Eligibility criteria for the Creator Programme may include, but are not limited to:
13.3.1. Age requirements. Creators must be at least [MINIMUM AGE REQUIREMENT FOR CREATORS - TO BE CONFIRMED BY LEGAL COUNSEL] years of age.
13.3.2. Location. Creators may be required to be located in India or other specified territories.
13.3.3. Account standing. The Creator's Account must be in good standing, with no history of serious or repeated violations of these Terms or the Community Guidelines.
13.3.4. Original content. Creators must produce and upload original Content that does not infringe the rights of third parties.
13.3.5. Authentic engagement. Creators must maintain authentic engagement on their Content and must not engage in Invalid Activity.
13.3.6. Identity verification. Creators must complete identity verification procedures, including Know Your Customer (KYC) checks.
13.3.7. Tax information. Creators must provide accurate tax information and comply with applicable tax requirements.
13.3.8. Minimum performance requirements. Creators must meet minimum performance requirements, including a minimum number of followers, views, or engagement metrics, as specified by POPLI.
13.3.9. Compliance. Creators must comply with these Terms, the Community Guidelines, the Creator Programme Terms, and all applicable laws and regulations.

13.4. Meeting the eligibility criteria does not guarantee admission to the Creator Programme. POPLI retains sole discretion in determining which Users are accepted into the Creator Programme. Acceptance is confirmed only upon receipt of an explicit communication from POPLI.

13.5. POPLI may introduce, modify, restrict, suspend, or discontinue the Creator Programme at any time, subject to applicable law. POPLI may also modify the eligibility criteria, programme terms, earning rates, or other programme features at any time.

13.6. Creators must comply with all applicable laws, including but not limited to tax laws, advertising laws, and intellectual property laws, in connection with their participation in the Creator Programme and their Earnings.

13.7. Creators are responsible for ensuring that their Content does not contain any third-party intellectual property rights, including music, images, or video clips, unless they have obtained all necessary rights, licences, and permissions.
14. VIEW-BASED EARNINGS
14.1. Creators may be eligible to earn Earnings based on views of their Content, subject to the terms of the Creator Programme and these Terms.

14.2. Displayed View Count. The view count displayed on the Platform represents the total number of views of your Content, as calculated by POPLI's systems. A displayed view count does not, by itself, indicate that every displayed view is eligible to generate Earnings.

14.3. Eligible Views. Only views that meet all of the criteria established by POPLI for monetization shall constitute Eligible Views and generate Earnings. POPLI may evaluate the following factors, among others, in determining whether a view is an Eligible View:
14.3.1. Genuine human activity. The view must be generated by a genuine human User and not by bots, scripts, automated systems, or other Invalid Activity.
14.3.2. Watch duration. The view must meet minimum watch duration requirements as determined by POPLI.
14.3.3. Duplicate or repeated activity. Views from the same User or device may be counted only once or may be limited in accordance with POPLI's policies.
14.3.4. Geographic eligibility. The view must originate from a geographic location that is eligible for monetization.
14.3.5. Content eligibility. The Content must be eligible for monetization, which may depend on content type, suitability, and compliance with policies.
14.3.6. Account eligibility. Both the Creator's Account and the viewing User's Account must be in good standing and free from violations.
14.3.7. Fraud signals. The view must not be associated with any fraud signals or Invalid Activity.
14.3.8. Traffic source. The view must originate from legitimate traffic sources and not from paid, incentivized, or otherwise invalid sources.
14.3.9. Advertiser or campaign requirements. Views may be subject to additional requirements for specific monetization campaigns or advertiser arrangements.
14.3.10. Platform monetization rules. The view must comply with all other rules, policies, and procedures established by POPLI for monetization.

14.4. POPLI does not guarantee any fixed amount per view, and the earning rate may vary based on factors including but not limited to the Creator's eligibility, Content type, geographic location, advertiser demand, Platform policies, and programme terms.

14.5. The earning formulas, rates, eligibility conditions, or programme structures may be separately communicated through the Creator Programme interface, dashboard, programme terms, or other official POPLI communications. Creators are responsible for reviewing all such communications.

14.6. POPLI reserves the right to change the basis for calculating Earnings, including but not limited to the factors considered for Eligible Views, the earning rates, and the method of calculation, at any time.
15. INVALID AND ARTIFICIAL VIEWS
15.1. POPLI strictly prohibits any form of Invalid Activity. Invalid Activity includes, but is not limited to:
15.1.1. Use of bots, scripts, automated software, or any other non-human methods to generate views, likes, comments, shares, followers, or any other engagement metric.
15.1.2. Click farms, view farms, engagement exchanges, or any other services that artificially inflate engagement.
15.1.3. Purchased views, likes, comments, shares, followers, or any other engagement metric.
15.1.4. Self-view manipulation, including repeatedly viewing your own Content through multiple accounts, devices, or sessions.
15.1.5. Use of device farms, emulators, virtual machines, or any other technology to simulate multiple Users or devices.
15.1.6. Repeated artificial refreshing or reloading of Content to increase view counts.
15.1.7. Coordinated manipulation, including groups of Users working together to artificially inflate engagement.
15.1.8. Incentivized fake engagement, including offering rewards or incentives to other Users for generating engagement.
15.1.9. Fraudulent traffic, including traffic generated through paid redirects, pop-unders, or other deceptive methods.
15.1.10. Automated accounts, including accounts created and operated by bots or automated systems.
15.1.11. Exploitation of platform vulnerabilities, including using any bug, vulnerability, or unintended feature of the Platform to manipulate metrics.
15.1.12. Attempts to bypass or evade fraud detection systems, including using VPNs, proxies, or other methods to conceal geographic location or device identity.
15.1.13. Any other activity that artificially inflates, manipulates, or distorts any metric on the Platform.

15.2. Consequences of Invalid Activity. If POPLI determines, in its sole discretion, that you have engaged in or benefited from Invalid Activity, POPLI may take any of the following actions, without limitation:
15.2.1. Exclude some or all views, likes, comments, shares, or other engagement from being counted or considered for monetization.
15.2.2. Withhold some or all Earnings, Rewards, or other benefits.
15.2.3. Adjust, reverse, or claw back some or all Earnings, Rewards, or other benefits.
15.2.4. Reverse, cancel, or invalidate Rewards, Coins, or Virtual Gifts.
15.2.5. Conduct an investigation into your Account and Content.
15.2.6. Suspend or terminate your participation in the Creator Programme.
15.2.7. Suspend or terminate your Account, with or without notice.
15.2.8. Recover or set off any amounts improperly credited or paid to you, where legally permissible.
15.2.9. Report your activities to law enforcement or regulatory authorities.

15.3. POPLI uses automated fraud detection systems to identify Invalid Activity. In the event of suspected Invalid Activity, POPLI reserves the right to withhold payment pending investigation. POPLI shall use reasonable efforts to complete its investigation in a timely manner.
15.4. Safeguards. POPLI acknowledges that there may be instances where a legitimate Creator receives unusual traffic that could be falsely flagged as Invalid Activity. In such cases:
15.4.1. POPLI shall not automatically presume that the Creator engaged in Invalid Activity merely because unusual traffic occurred.
15.4.2. POPLI shall consider additional information, including the Creator's history of compliance, the nature of the traffic, and the Creator's explanation.
15.4.3. Creators may request a review of any adverse determination by contacting POPLI through the mechanisms provided on the Platform. POPLI shall review such requests in good faith.
